issue: मंगल की सेवा — the book prints 'मंगल' in quotation marks, as it does 'आदित' (stanza 4); with वार शनिश्चर (stanza 3) and सात बार की महिमा बरनी (stanza 6) the āratī names the days of the week, so मंगल is Tuesday (the Goddess's day).
ब्रह्मा विष्णु महेश सहसफण लिए — सहसफण is 'the thousand-hooded' (Śeṣa); लिए read as 'taking along'. Other versions have फल लिए (holding fruit).
our reading: Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Maheśa, with the thousand-hooded Śeṣa, stand at your door to give their offerings.
alternatives: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Maheśa and Śeṣa stand at your door holding their offerings.

issue: वार शनिश्चर कुंकुम बरणो जब लुँकड़ पर हुकुम करे — बरणो read as वर्ण (colour); लुँकड़ as लौंकड़ा (Platts: a boy attendant of a goddess; लौकड़िया-बीर is Bhairava), the attendant called Lāṅgur.
our reading: On Saturday your hue is of kumkum, when you give your command to Luṅkaṛ, your attendant Lāṅgur.
alternatives: On Saturday kumkum is offered (बरनना: described, praised) when you command your attendant.

issue: आदित वारी आदि भवानी — वारी read as वार (day): 'on Sunday', in the āratī's run of weekdays; वारी is also 'given up for (in love)'.
our reading: On Sunday, O primal Bhavānī, you take away the suffering of your own devotee.
alternatives: O primal Bhavānī, to whom I give myself on Sunday, …
